issues.problem: Meaning line narrowed it to one meeting; the idiom says every encounter is unique and to be treasured
issues.action: mean -> 'every encounter happens only once, so treasure it'

issues.problem: 'making rapid, constant progress' could describe a person's improvement; the idiom is said of a field or technology advancing day by day
issues.action: mean -> 'advancing rapidly day by day, as technology does'

issues.problem: Meaning line lacked the criticism of selfish, inconsiderate behaviour
issues.action: mean -> 'behaving selfishly as if no one else were there'

issues.problem: Meaning line too close to yj060 紆余曲折 and yj042 一進一退; it is said of a life or story
issues.action: mean -> 'a life or story full of dramatic ups and downs'

issues.problem: Meaning line dropped the image of being in a fog about the situation, and was close to other 'lost' wordings
issues.action: mean -> 'lost in a fog, with no idea how to proceed'

issues.problem: Checked each reading character by character (e.g. 十人十色 じゅうにんといろ, 老若男女 ろうにゃくなんにょ, 十中八九 じっちゅうはっく, 二束三文 にそくさんもん, 順風満帆 じゅんぷうまんぱん) and each form (玉石混交, 和気藹々, 絶体絶命). All correct; every entry is in present-day use, with no dated, regional or vulgar items and no true near-duplicates
